name: ToggleButton
summary: A button that stays pressed or not: bold, mute, grid view. aria-pressed tells assistive tech the state.
useWhen: One setting that is on or off and applies at once, shown as a button in a toolbar
A formatting control (bold, italic) or a view switch that can be on alone
An icon only on and off control in a toolbar, named by its label
avoidWhen: A choice between two or more options where one is always on
A setting in a form that is saved with the form
An action that runs once (save, send)

onPressedChange.description: Called with the new pressed value.

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px in the default density. A ButtonGroup passes its size; this prop wins.

emphasis.description: As Button. No link: a link that stays pressed reads as neither.

shape.description: default takes radius.control (Desk draws it as a pill), pill is fully round, square takes radius.sm.

start.description: Leading content: a system icon name or a node. 16px at every size.

end.description: Trailing content: a system icon name or a node.

icon.description: The icon only form: an icon name or a node. Then label is the accessible name.

label.description: The accessible name of the icon only form (aria-label). Required with icon.

disabled.description: aria-disabled and data-disabled; stays focusable; does not toggle.

children.description: The visible label: the setting it turns on, a noun (Grid view).

a11y.focus: In the tab order in every state. A 2px ring on keyboard focus, the doubled ring on a solid fill.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the next control

a11y.announce: aria-pressed is announced as pressed or not pressed with the name. The name stays the same in both states.
notes: Pressed is not told by color alone: an on toggle also gets a 2px inner ring.
In forced colors an on toggle is drawn in Highlight and HighlightText.
Keep the label the same in both states. Do not swap Show to Hide: aria-pressed carries the state.
A ButtonGroup passes size, emphasis and shape through context; a prop on the toggle wins.

en.label: The setting it turns on, a noun or a short phrase in sentence case: Grid view, Mute alerts. The same in both states.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: عرض الشبكة، كتم التنبيهات.

angular.note: aria-pressed and data-state on the host, as Radix Toggle sets them. onPressedChange is the pressedChange output of [(pressed)]; defaultPressed seeds the local state when pressed is not bound. start, end and icon take an icon name or a TemplateRef. Button.css is used as is.

styles.studio: The overlay fill steps up and a 2px inner ring shows when on.
styles.desk: Pill shaped; on is the stronger fill with the ring; no roll label.
styles.neutral: Tokens only: the same on fill and ring in Neutral's colors.

mistakes.wrong: A toggle whose label switches between Show and Hide
mistakes.right: One label, Show guides; aria-pressed says the state

mistakes.wrong: Two toggles where exactly one must be on
An on state told only by color
mistakes.right: The inner ring the component draws; do not override it away
